title: All that fuss for this?
literal_meaning: For this matter, I pushed the boat off to Calcutta.
meaning_odia: ଏତିକି କଥା ପାଇଁ ଏତେ ଆୟୋଜନ ବା ଚିନ୍ତା କାହିଁକି—ଏହି ଥଟ୍ଟାର ସ୍ୱରରେ କଥାଟିକୁ ଏଠାରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଛୋଟ କଥା ସହ କଲିକତାକୁ ନାଆ ପଠାଇବାର ବଡ଼ ଚିତ୍ର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: A small-sounding “this matter” is met with the grand gesture of sending a boat to Calcutta. This edition reads the mismatch as a playful response to needless fuss: was such a large undertaking really needed for that?
usage_example: Someone gives a long, anxious account of a problem that turns out to have a simple solution. A friend might respond with this rhyme before explaining the fix. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The destination କଲିକତା gives the imagined journey a concrete endpoint. The repeated କୁ ending in କଥାକୁ and କଲିକତାକୁ turns the response into a quick rhyme, with the boat journey supplying the comic exaggeration.
